name: retired-version-0x02
description: Version byte 0x02 — the version the LIVE CLUSTER RUNS until the rotation event, and the case that matters at the cutover. A v3 verifier must refuse it outright rather than best-effort decode: v2's BlockExport has six fields where v3 has seven, so a lenient decoder reads `logs` out of the wrong offset. The frozen v2 corpus at ../proof-batch-v2/ is the same gate's REAL v2 bytes rather than a flipped byte, kept as the pre-rotation record; the test that reads that tree is prover-side, on the shelf branch.
expectedError: bad version 2, want 3 (v2 is retired: refuse, do not adapt -- its BlockExport has six fields where v3 has seven)
